title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.18458v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with record

translated_title: 何时信任模拟的患者反应：用于血管加压药决策支持的支持门控世界模型
translated_abstract: 临床世界模型让语言模型智能体接触预测的患者反应，但模拟对于支持度不足的治疗或不熟悉的医院可能不可靠。我们提出了支持门控世界模型决策支持方法，这是“提议—模拟—精炼”智能体的一个轻量级扩展。一个循环动力学集成模型预测对所记录的去甲肾上腺素剂量类别的短期生理反应，同时一个行为模型估计观察性动作支持度。该界面会在支持不足或集成分歧过大时隐藏预测，并在没有候选方案合格时选择弃权。在eICU-CRD上的评估涵盖70家医院和30,700个决策转换，其中14家医院留作测试。在62.0%的事实转换覆盖率下，联合门控的MAP平均绝对误差为7.3 mmHg，而相同覆盖率下随机选择为9.2 mmHg。门控智能体与记录达到60.0%的一致性。
tldr: 该论文提出支持门控世界模型决策支持方法，利用行为模型估计的动作支持度与动力学集成模型的分歧度进行联合门控，在模拟预测不可靠时主动隐藏预测或弃权，从而在eICU-CRD数据上以62%覆盖率将MAP预测误差从9.2 mmHg降至7.3 mmHg。
